title: NBN POI 4CAB (Caboolture), 4APL (Aspley) - Cable Relocation and Replacement
current_summary: Maintenance to relocate and replace a cable affecting NBN POIs 4CAB (Caboolture) and 4APL (Aspley) has been completed. All services are expected to be restored as of Mon 17 Aug 7:00 AM AEST. Thank you for your patience during this work.

updates.content:
Planned maintenance is scheduled on backhaul links serving the NBN Caboolture (4CAB) and Aspley (4APL) POIs. An upstream provider will be relocating and replacing a cable. Some NBN services in these areas may be affected for up to 8 hours within the maintenance window.

Window: Sun 16 Aug 11:00 PM to Mon 17 Aug 7:00 AM AEST.

Our team will monitor throughout and work to minimise disruption. No action is required from customers; services should restore automatically once the work is complete. We appreciate your patience.

Scheduled maintenance at Caboolture (4CAB) and Aspley (4APL) has been completed. All NBN services are expected to be restored as of Mon 17 Aug 7:00 AM AEST. Thank you for your patience while our upstream provider carried out this work.
